births.label: Live births (Taldau: Число родившихся (живыми)), quarterly cumulative

population.label: Population at start of month (Численность населения на начало периода)

marriages.label: Registered marriages, quarterly cumulative (Number of registered marriages)

income.label: Per-capita nominal money income, tenge, quarterly

housing_pc.label: Housing per resident, m2 (Обеспеченность жильем на одного проживающего), annual

marriages_annual.label: Registered marriages, annual (fallback if no quarterly file)

income_annual.label: Per-capita nominal money income, tenge, annual (fallback)

drivers.name: h
drivers.label: Housing per resident, last published year (yoy log change)

deviations.why: Taldau publishes quarterly births and marriages by region only from January-March 2014
deviations.pre_registered_result: not estimable: no quarterly regional births before 2014

deviations.what: Real wage replaced by real per-capita money income (quarterly, deflated by the regional CPI; same lag 4)
deviations.why: no quarterly regional wage series was downloaded; per-capita income is the closest quarterly regional income measure obtained

deviations.what: Housing commissioned replaced by housing per resident (m2, annual, last published year)
deviations.why: the housing-commissioned series was not obtained; the housing-stock series measures the same space constraint, more slowly

deviations.what: Population after January 2024 projected at each region's growth over the previous 12 months
deviations.why: the downloaded population file ends at 1 January 2024
deviations.pre_registered_result: the pre-registration assumed published population for every quarter

deviations.why: 2015Q3 falls before the first estimation quarter (2016Q1); 2018Q2 is the South Kazakhstan / Shymkent split

prior_runs.what: Same model, with marriages and income entering as annual figures (last published year), run before the quarterly marriage and income files were obtained
prior_runs.status: superseded: the quarterly data match the pre-registered specification, so the quarterly run is the main result whatever its sign
